name: NASA SMAP L4 (SPL4SMGP v007)
type: Land model that uses satellite data (not a direct measurement)
period: April 2015 to June 2025, monthly mean of 3-hourly values
product_and_unit: NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007 on Google Earth Engine; unit m3/m3 (volume fraction); resolution about 9 km

name: NASA POWER
used_for: Surface and root-zone soil wetness (soil_wet_surface, soil_wet_root)
period: January 2015 to December 2025 (daily, aggregated to monthly)
product_and_unit: Relative index from 0 to 1 (not an actual water percentage). Most likely GWETTOP for the surface (about 0-5 cm) and GWETROOT for the root zone (about 0-100 cm). Resolution about half a degree
